ERR_BLE_ADV.message: The board could not start advertising (code {rc})

ERR_BLE_GATT.message: Bluetooth service {uuid} could not be changed (code {rc})

ERR_BLE_SVC_LOCKED.hint: This service belongs to the board: add a service of your own instead.

ERR_BLE_NOT_FOUND.hint: Check the UUID, or apply the Bluetooth settings first.

ERR_BLE_NO_MEM.hint: Make the buffers smaller, or remove a characteristic you do not need.

ERR_BLE_NO_TX.hint: Give the characteristic a send buffer with notify or indicate.

ERR_BLE_NO_RX.hint: Give the characteristic a receive buffer and allow write.

ERR_BLE_TX_FULL.message: Bluetooth {uuid} is full: {len} bytes were not sent
ERR_BLE_TX_FULL.hint: Send less often, or make the send buffer larger.

ERR_BLE_RX_FULL.message: Bluetooth {uuid} is full: {len} bytes received were dropped
ERR_BLE_RX_FULL.hint: Write less often, or make the receive buffer larger.

ERR_BLE_TOO_LONG.message: {len} bytes are too long for Bluetooth {uuid} (at most {max})
ERR_BLE_TOO_LONG.hint: Send less at once, or make the buffer larger.

ERR_BLE_BAD_ARG.message: A Bluetooth setting is not valid

ERR_BLE_FRAG.message: Bluetooth {uuid}: a packet came out of order and its frame was dropped
